LanguageData.FPW.ModeDesc:
Switch the wand's fire mode.

Single shot: one orb at a time, long range and high accuracy.
Burst: three orbs, shorter range and lower accuracy.
LanguageData.FPW.NoPsylink: {PAWN_nameDef} has no psylink or psycast. In {PAWN_possessive} hand the wand is only a stick.
LanguageData.FPW.NoPsyfocus: {PAWN_nameDef} does not have enough psyfocus to cast.
